entities.name: Dušan Šakota
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dušan Šakota is a Serbian-Greek former professional basketball player. At 6'10 3⁄4" tall, he played the power forward position and was known for his shooting ability. He has won two triple crowns in his career. He was the team captain of AEK Athens of the Greek Basket League for five seasons, and with the club, he won the 2018 FIBA Champions League title, the 2018 Greek Cup title, and the 2019 FIBA Intercontinental Cup title.
